.talkbubble {
  width: 130px; 
  background: #eff8fe;
  border: 1px solid #AED7FF ;
  position: relative;
  -moz-border-radius:    5px;
  -webkit-border-radius: 5px;
  border-radius:        5px;
}
.talkbubble:before {
  content:"";
  position: absolute;
  left: 100%;
  top: 10px;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  border-top: 8px solid transparent;
  border-left: 11px solid #AED7FF;
  border-bottom: 11px solid transparent;
}
.talkbubble:after {
  content:"";
  position: absolute;
  left: 100%;
  top: 11px;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  border-top: 7px solid transparent;
  border-left: 10px solid #eff8fe;
  border-bottom: 10px solid transparent;
}
.talkbubble1 { 
  background: #fff;
  padding: 5px;
  border: 1px solid #fff ;
  -moz-border-radius:    5px;
  -webkit-border-radius: 5px;
  border-radius:        5px;
}
